local equip_ammy = 3048

macro(100, "MIGHT", function() 
    if hppercent() <= 40 and (getFinger() == null or getFinger():getId() ~= amulet) then
            g_game.equipItemId(amulet)
            delay(200)
    elseif hppercent() >= 50 and (getFinger() == null or equip_ammy and getFinger():getId() ~= equip_ammy) then
        g_game.equipItemId(equip_ammy)
        delay(200)
    end
end)

local wands = {
["destroyer"] = 33051, 
["midnight asura"] = 30399,
["dawnfire asura"] = 30399
}

macro(100, "Change Wand", function()
    if not g_game.isAttacking() then return end
    local Utarget = g_game.getAttackingCreature()
    for key, value in pairs(wands) do
        if Utarget and wands[Utarget:getName():lower()] then
            if not getLeft() or getLeft():getId() ~= tonumber(value) then
                moveToSlot(wands[Utarget:getName():lower()], SlotLeft)
            end
        end
    end
end)

DropItem = macro(500,"Drop Pots",function() 
    local sourceContainer = 5926
    local itemId1 = 3031
    local delay = 200
    local containers = g_game.getContainers()
    local source = nil
    local dest = nil

    for c, cont in pairs(containers) do
      local cId = cont:getContainerItem():getId()
      if cId == destContainer then
        dest = cont
      end
      if cId == sourceContainer then 
        source = cont
      end
    end

      for i, item in pairs(source:getItems()) do
          if item:getId() == itemId1 then
            schedule(delay,function()
              g_game.move(item,{x=5692, y=5528, z=7},item:getCount())
            end)

        end
      end
  end)

end)
